programmes.d: When a university student goes missing, her mother a former cop goes in search for her.
A marine biologist and a laissez-faire dive instructor must team up to save their beloved reef.
A cop-turned-writer creates suspicion when she publishes her first novel.
Ghostwriter Becca unexpectedly ends up on the trail from a legendary novel with action star Lee.
When Isla’s art unexpectedly sells to Mark, a second commission sees them falling in love.
An FBI agent must negotiate with a woman holding a hospital hostage in order to get her hands on an experimental drug.
A lawyer is riding high after receiving a Not Guilty verdict for her client, but has to look over her shoulder when a woman she meets in a traffic accident is not all she appears to be.
A former colleague seeks Vicki’s help to find out what kind of creature is now in possession of his body.
A were-cat seeking revenge against the hunter that murdered her brother plays a cat and mouse game with Mike.
Storm chaser April, whose parents died in a twister during her childhood, must warn her brother and his unsespecting town of a massive storm heading their way before he meets the same fate.
A marketing designer’s favourite foster dog is adopted by a down on his luck furniture designer.
Liz and Kappa Psi Psi prep for Gamma Fair and T-shirt sales. Alan’s class inspires Anna’s look change.
Gamma Pi Omicron pledges retreat while Pete recovers. Sarah bonds with Jordan, and Allison gets her way.
Tara marries Joe, a stranger as part of a TV show, but soon starts to fall for him after all.
A chef bets she can turn around the worst restaurant in the city but ends up falling for the owner.
Sparks fly when Hazel works with trivia host Theo to promote her new subscription box.
When her dog is killed, Tara cancels her wedding. But her dog's ghost and her small town have a surprise.
